title: Inference Resilience Compass and procurement trigger index
creator: Sofia Nguyen
description: Build an actionable index and visual 'Compass' that helps procurement, sales, and PMs prioritize model-sourcing actions by weighting supply fragility, latency economics, regional availability, and buyer cohort tolerance. Outcome: a reproducible scoring rubric, automated signal ingestion feeds, and a dashboard with prioritized procurement trigger recommendations and playbook steps for rapid response.
acceptance_criteria: Scoring rubric defined: fragility, latency-sensitivity, contract-risk, quant-compatibility, and business criticality with clear weights
Data feeds wired: daily ingest from model-availability sentinel, regional latency telemetry, pricing & contract cadence, and public model release trackers
Dashboard prototype: interactive Compass view showing quadrant placement for top 50 model variants and per-region trigger signals
Procurement trigger set: 5 deterministic trigger rules (eg. >30% availability drop in region X over 48h) with recommended playbook steps and escalation path
Stakeholder signoff: procurement, SRE, and two enterprise PMs approve rubric and escalation playbook
comments: 2026-02-21 - Kickoff: aligned on owner list and signal priorities. Decided to prioritize availability, latency, and price volatility as first-order signals.
2026-02-25 - Data engineering: Daniel set up a daily snapshot bucket for model availability. ETA for first feed: 2026-03-05.
2026-03-01 - Design review: Aisha provided feedback — Compass needs hover state with recommended remedial action per trigger. Action: add short playbook text for each quadrant.

2026-03-04 - PM synthesis: Ran buyer-cohort interviews (3 enterprise accounts). Key finding: finance teams tolerate short degraded latency if cost savings >=15%, product teams prefer stability over cost for customer-facing flows.
2026-03-07 - Engineering note: evaluating KG-based provenance tracker vs CSV ingestion. Chose staged CSV with provenance headers to ship fast, roadmap item to move to KG in Q2.
2026-03-09 - Review feedback from Procurement: add contract renewal window signal and normalize across vendors. Added to rubric as 'renewal proximity'.
2026-03-10 - Status: dashboard prototype V0 deployed to staging. Need production dashboards and alerting thresholds next.
notes: Trade-offs discussed: faster shipping with CSV-based snapshots vs longer-term graph provenance. Short-term decision taken to ship CSV + provenance headers; plan to iterate after initial signals stabilize. Next sprint: add automated anomaly detection to reduce false-positive triggers.
playbook_summary: Each trigger resolves to a 3-step play: 1) auto-failover to fallback model variant or region (if latency SLO breached), 2) notify procurement with normalized impact score and recommended negotiation lever, 3) create urgent SRE incident if availability persists >2h.
stakeholder_signoffs: Enterprise PMs: Lena Hoffman, Carlos Gomez - pending
